positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Responsible for ARM Linux kernel porting, integration, driver writing, unit testing, and documentation for various ARMv4, v4T, v5TE, v6, and v7 cores.
• Reviewed and recommended changes for MontaVista kernel engineer submissions as a Linux kernel gatekeeper.
• Extended ARM Linux kernel alignment exception handler to add support for Thumb instructions.
• Coauthored ARM Linux kernel KGDB.
• Coauthored Yet Another Xen ARM port for linux.conf.au 2008.
• Attended ARM Technical Advisory Board meetings to review and comment on ARM architecture updates.
• Previewed ARM TrustZone features for integration strategies in future MontaVista releases.

positions.title: Principal Engineer
positions.description:
• Provided technical input to Marketing Business team for customer project proposals and wrote firmware sections of Customer Requirements Documents.
• Identified and implemented BIOS modifications for custom embedded networking board as well as Linux and FreeBSD bring-up on same.
• Led firmware development for HP PA-8500 3-slot 6U CPCI system controller as well as HP-UX 10.20/32-bit kernel bring-up, debug and qualification testing, and assisted other HP-UX kernel engineers in bring-up of product on HP-UX 11/64-bit kernel.
• System Engineer for development of Ultra Sparc IIe single slot 6U CPCI system controller.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed and customized HP VME Workstation family firmware and diagnostics, integrating PCI, PMC, Fast LAN, Ultra SCSI, F/W SCSI, and enhanced graphics hardware options, as well as source code modifications for HP-UX operating system.
• Mentored new firmware/software engineers and contractors, providing technical consultation and support for upgrades and customized diagnostics.
• Maintained PA7300LC simulator for emulation of VME product platform hardware specific features.
• Provided firmware modifications for upgrades of Models 735 and 755 Workstation Platforms and wrote various customized diagnostics to assist hardware team development and debug efforts.

positions.title: Senior Hardware Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed MC68302 based modem network controller with 4MB zero-wait-state DRAM, 2MB flash EEPROM, 16 19.2kbps UART channels, and IEEE 802.3 10BaseT port for modem pool management via SNMP.
• Designed Actel A1020 FPGA based NDX system bus controller interface used on all NDX boards installed in 18-slot backplane.
• Led codesign of NDX System Controller and Digital I/O boards based on TMS320C31, integrating fast page mode DRAM, flash EEPROM, SRAM, and multi-protocol serial I/O with integrated DMA.
• Developed automatic DSU/CSU dial backup switch for high-speed digital leased line backup via 9600-baud modem, supporting multi-protocol V.24, X.21, and, V.35 interfaces.
• Designed GAL based DRAM controller as a replacement for discontinued TI THCT4500 component, ensuring alternate sources availability and providing PCB artwork via PADS-PCB.

positions.title: Hardware Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed dual TMS320C25 DSP and 64MB audio data DRAM ISA cards for AKG DSE-7000 Digital Sound Editor Workstation.
• Developed digital I/O interface for the DSE-7000 5.25" single slot drive bay Analog I/O Module.
• Enhanced audio bandwidth capabilities from 32kHz to 48kHz sampling rate, improving dynamic range and SNR by resolving quantization errors.
• Provided C and TMS320 assembler code for production testing and diagnostics of custom hardware.

positions.title: Design Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed and wrote firmware for Z80 based system controller, 512KB dual port video memory framestore with RS-170 output, system test simulator, and wrote microcode for custom 24 MIPS DSP for AFGL full frame FLIR cryogenic thermal imaging system.
• Designed 128K by 16-bit dual port framestore ISA plug-in card and interrupt service handler for frame capture.
• Designed dual-port framestore for capturing digitized infrared video data from radiometric imaging scanner and acting as a frame buffer for host processor.
